extension.description: Spot confusable, invisible, and unusual Unicode characters with Chinese-aware rules. Offline, with English and Chinese interfaces.
virtualWorkspaces.description: Scans files, untitled documents, remote files, and notebook code cells only.
configuration.title: Unicode Inspector
configuration.allowChinesePunctuation: Allow common Chinese punctuation. Disable to flag fullwidth punctuation in code.
configuration.allowCommonSymbols: Allow common unit, math, and currency symbols.
configuration.allowPinyin: Allow accented pinyin and combining tone marks in supported pinyin contexts.
configuration.allowedCharacters: Additional characters to allow. Enter literal characters, not a regular expression.
configuration.allowedCodepointRanges: Additional hexadecimal ranges to allow, such as 0400-04FF. All characters in these ranges are allowed, including confusables and controls.
configuration.debounceMs: Delay in milliseconds after editing before scanning.
configuration.maxFileCharacters: Maximum document length in UTF-16 code units. Larger documents are explicitly marked as not scanned. Set to 0 for no limit.
